# Run scenarios & log {.unnumbered}

*This chapter records the simulation scenarios maintained in the repository and
the rationale for each. The authoritative log is `runs/RUN_LOG.md`.*

Each run builds on the previous one.

| ID | Name | In repo | Purpose |
|----|------|:-------:|---------|
| 001 | Pioneer_17 | no | Original baseline setup; archived elsewhere. |
| 002 | `002_P18_flood` | yes | Pioneer 18 with an artificial flood pulse and a simplified `fluxflag.prop` for deep budget testing. |
| 003 | `003_P18_flood_flat` | yes | Copy of 002 with the flood pulse and a quiescent (flat) ocean tide for the first 14 days, to isolate flux-direction inconsistencies across the Pioneer mouth. |

## 001 → 002

Introduced the artificial flood and simplified `fluxflag.prop` (fewer transect
regions) so the boundary-flux budget can be closed and tested cleanly. Added the
`GEN_1` general tracer. Also enabled `iadjust_mass_consv0(3) = 1`
(mass-conservation adjustment for the GEN module) — **this produced NaNs**.

## 002 → 003

Tide forcing switched from harmonic (`bctides.in`, `iettype = 3`) to
space/time-varying (`iettype = 4`, `elev2D.th.nc`). Days 0–14 are held flat at
0 m; from day 16 the boundary tide is identical to 002. The
`iadjust_mass_consv0(3)` flag is **disabled** to avoid the NaNs seen in 002.
See [the flat-tide method](../part2-model-setup/07-boundary-and-tidal-forcing.qmd).

## Common settings

Run length 91 days (`rnday`), `dt = 45 s`, start 2021-04-01 00:00 UTC. Output is
spooled at 15-minute cadence into daily stacks.
